pages.ko: "냠냠, 꿀꺽! 냠냠, 꿀꺽!" 호리네 집에 놀러 온 콩이는 간식 시간이 제일 좋아요. 접시에 김이 모락모락 나는 찐 고구마가 놓이자, 콩이 볼주머니가 벌써 빵빵해져요. "우와, 맛있겠다!"
pages.t: "Nom nom, gulp! Nom nom, gulp!" Kongi, who came over to play at Hori's house, loves snack time the most. As soon as a plate of steaming sweet potatoes is set down, Kongi's cheek pouches are already puffed up. "Wow, that looks delicious!"

pages.ko: 콩이는 고구마를 덥석 크게 베어 물고 후다닥 삼켰어요. 우물우물도 없이 꿀꺽— 또 덥석, 또 꿀꺽! "빨리 먹어야 더 먹지!" 볼이 미어터지게 입에 잔뜩 넣어요.
pages.t: Kongi took a big bite of the sweet potato and gulped it down in a hurry. No chewing at all, just gulp— then another big bite, another gulp! "I have to eat fast to get more!" He stuffed his cheeks so full they were about to burst.

pages.ko: 그런데 갑자기— "딸꾹! 딸꾹!" 딸꾹질이 나고, 목이 답답해요. 급하게 삼켜서 딸꾹질이 멈추질 않아 콩이 눈이 그렁그렁. 얼굴이 발그레 상기됐어요.
pages.t: But then, suddenly— "Hic! Hic!" He got the hiccups, and his throat felt tight. From swallowing too fast, the hiccups wouldn't stop, and Kongi's eyes welled up with tears. His face turned red.

pages.ko: 엄마가 얼른 다가와 콩이 등을 살살 쓸어 주고 물을 한 모금 건넸어요. "천천히, 꿀꺽." 딸꾹질이 사르르 가라앉았어요. "너무 급하게 삼켜서 그래. 엄마랑 천천히 먹는 법 배워 볼까?" 콩이가 고개를 끄덕여요.
pages.t: Mom hurried over, rubbed Kongi's back gently, and handed him a sip of water. "Slowly, swallow." The hiccups gently faded away. "That happened because you swallowed too fast. Want to learn how to eat slowly with Mom?" Kongi nodded.

pages.ko: 엄마가 재미난 이야기를 해 줬어요. "입속에는 방앗간이 있어. 이가 콩콩콩 방아를 찧어야 음식이 폭신폭신해진단다." 콩이 눈앞에 그림이 그려졌어요. 하얀 이들이 절구처럼 콩콩 찧으니 고구마가 보들보들 반죽이 돼요. "우와, 그래서 꼭꼭 씹어야 하는구나!"
pages.t: Mom told him a fun story. "There's a little mill inside your mouth. Your teeth have to pound away like a mill to make the food nice and soft." A picture formed in Kongi's mind. As his white teeth pounded away like a mortar, the sweet potato turned into soft, fluffy dough. "Wow, so that's why I have to chew chew!"

pages.ko: "우리 방아 찧기 놀이 해 볼까?" 엄마가 속닥였어요. "한 입 조금 물고, 이로 꼭꼭꼭 여러 번, 그다음 꿀꺽!" 호리도 옆에서 신났어요. "누가 더 꼭꼭 잘 씹나 시합하자!" 콩이 눈이 반짝 빛났어요.
pages.t: "Shall we play the milling game?" Mom whispered. "Take a small bite, chew chew chew many times with your teeth, then gulp!" Hori got excited too. "Let's have a contest to see who chews the best!" Kongi's eyes sparkled.

pages.ko: 콩이가 고구마를 조금만 콕 떼어 입에 넣고, 꼭꼭꼭 여러 번 씹어요. 하나, 둘, 셋… 우물우물, 오물오물! 씹을수록 달콤한 맛이 입안 가득 퍼져요. "우와, 이렇게 맛있었어?" 꼭꼭 냠냠, 천천히!
pages.t: Kongi pinched off just a small piece of sweet potato, put it in his mouth, and chewed chew chew many times. One, two, three... munch munch, chomp chomp! The more he chewed, the more the sweet flavor spread through his mouth. "Wow, it was this delicious?" Chew chew, nom nom, slowly!

pages.ko: 천천히 다 먹고 나니 배가 편안하고 속이 개운해요. 딸꾹질도, 목멤도 하나 없어요! "천천히 먹으니까 하나도 안 답답해!" 그 순간 콩이 볼주머니 둘레가 반짝반짝, 콩이가 폴짝 뛰었어요. 해냈어요!
pages.t: After eating slowly, his tummy felt comfortable and settled. No hiccups, no choking at all! "Eating slowly doesn't feel stuffy at all!" At that moment, the outline of Kongi's cheek pouches sparkled, and Kongi jumped for joy. He did it!

pages.ko: 이제 콩이는 규칙을 알아요. 하나, 한 입은 조금만! 둘, 이로 꼭꼭 여러 번 씹기! 셋, 다 씹으면 꿀꺽 꿀꺽! 다음 날 밥상에서도 콩이는 조금씩 떼어 꼭꼭 씹어요. 꼭꼭 냠냠, 천천히!
pages.t: Now Kongi knows the rule. One, take just a small bite! Two, chew chew many times with your teeth! Three, once it's all chewed, gulp it down! The next day at the dinner table, Kongi took small bites and chewed them well. Chew chew, nom nom, slowly!

pages.ko: 엄마가 콩이를 꼭 안아 주었어요. "우리 콩이, 이제 꼭꼭 씹어 먹는 멋진 어린이네!" 이제 콩이는 알아요. 천천히 꼭꼭 씹으면 더 맛있고 배도 편안하다는 걸. 꼭꼭 냠냠, 천천히!
pages.t: Mom gave Kongi a big hug. "My Kongi is now a wonderful kid who chews his food well!" Now Kongi knows that chewing slowly makes food taste better and keeps his tummy comfortable. Chew chew, nom nom, slowly!
